subject: FinSecure MAP: security scope & retention - scoping questions
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lewis <emma.lewis@finsecure.com>, security@finsecure.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinSecure MAP: security scope & retention - scoping questions

Hi Emma / FinSecure security,

Thanks again for the call yesterday — great to get alignment on timelines. To make the mutual action plan (MAP) concrete for both teams, we need a few clarifications on the security/compliance gates so we can draft acceptance criteria for evaluation and close. Short bullets below — can you confirm by EOD Tuesday?

1) SOC 2 scope and timing
   - Is FinSecure expecting our SOC 2 Type II report (or a third-party SOC attestation) to be completed before go-live, or is a SOC 2 in-progress status + remediation plan acceptable for contract signature?

2) SIG/CAIQ status
   - You mentioned SIG was mostly done internally — do you need Redwood to submit the completed SIG/CAIQ questionnaire, or will you be ok with our SIG + supporting documentation (network diagrams, subprocessors list)?

3) DPA redlines & retention windows
   - FinSecure stated a 7-year retention requirement for transaction logs. Our default retention for production request/response logs is 12 months; we can offer contract-level retention overrides but need to understand the legal basis for 7 yrs and which data classes it applies to (PII, transaction metadata, complete payloads).

4) Data residency / backups
   - Any hard requirement to host logs/archives in EU sovereign regions? If yes, please confirm which country/region and whether backups must avoid cross-border replication.

5) Evidence & reviewers
   - Who will be the primary FinSecure reviewer(s) for SOC/infra evidence? We will package an evidence bundle (SOC artifacts, configuration screenshots, CAIQ export).

Attachments: redwood_map_template.xlsx (proposed MAP milestones), soc2-ask-list.pdf (list of SOC artifacts we typically provide).

Our ask: quick checkbox answers so we can convert the attached MAP into milestone commitments (dates for SOC deliverable, SIG submission, DPA sign). If there are contract-team constraints (e.g., cannot accept in-progress SOC), flag that and we’ll escalate.

Thanks,
Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Emma Lewis <emma.lewis@finsecure.com>

Cc: security@finsecure.com, legal@finsecure.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: FinSecure MAP: security scope & retention - scoping questions

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and I copied FinSecure security/legal so they can confirm specifics:

1) SOC 2: FinSecure policy prefers a completed SOC 2 Type II, but we can accept a SOC 2 in-progress status for contract signature if there is a binding remediation & milestone plan that results in Type II within 90 days post-signature.

2) SIG/CAIQ: We expect Redwood to submit a completed CAIQ (PDF export) and the supporting docs. That will be used by our reviewers as the initial intake.

3) Retention: The 7-year retention request applies to transaction logs tied to high-value settlements (internal legal requirement). We understand Redwood default is 12 months; please let us know contractual options (retention override, encrypted cold-archive, or customer-controlled export).

4) Data residency: Yes, logs for EU customers must remain in EU regions. Replication to non-EU backups is not permitted for this dataset.

5) Reviewers: Security contact here is security@finsecure.com (cc), and legal will provide a primary. I've asked legal to start a DPA redline review and aim to share an initial redline by Friday.

Forwarding their internal note for visibility.

Best,
Emma

--
Emma Lewis
Head of Security Assurance, FinSecure
emma.lewis@finsecure.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: FinSecure MAP: security scope & retention - scoping questions

Soojin / Laura,

Thanks Emma. Based on their answers, I drafted a concise MAP milestone set and a couple of technical retention options so we can present them in the call. High-level MAP (proposal):

- Week 0 (contracting): DPA redline received + mutual agreement to an SOC remediation milestone plan.
- Week 2: CAIQ (completed) + infra evidence bundle submitted to FinSecure reviewers.
- Week 6-12: SOC Type II validation window (FinSecure accepts in-progress + plan w/ Type II in 90 days).
- Week 12-16: Go/no-go decision following SOC completion and DPA sign-off.

Retention options to propose to legal (short list attached):
A) Contractual override: Redwood retains specified logs for 7 years in an EU-only cold-archive (access controlled by request/contract).
B) Customer-export + delete: Redwood provides an automated export of all relevant logs at contract start and deletes copies after 12 months; customer responsible for long-term storage.
C) Encrypted escrow: Logs encrypted with FinSecure-managed keys (KMIP/HSM) and stored in EU for 7 years; Redwood cannot decrypt without customer consent.

We should flag option C as operationally heavier and will require an architecture exception and review by infra (latency/restore impact). If FinSecure selects A, we need a short technical spec and an SOW addendum.

Attachment: retention-options.md (one-pager).

Recommend a quick 30-min decision call (see Laura comment below) and to surface any SOW/back-office implications to finance.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: RE: FinSecure MAP: security scope & retention - scoping questions

Team,

Directive: if FinSecure insists on a 7-year retention obligation for production payloads (not just metadata), escalate to Sales leadership and Legal immediately. Long retention of full payloads is a significant product and compliance change and could impact resale/compliance with other customers.

Acceptance criteria (proposed, to include in MAP):
- Signed DPA with explicit retention clause and who controls encryption keys.
- CAIQ submitted and validated by FinSecure reviewers.
- SOC 2 Type II delivered within 90 days of signature (in-progress + plan acceptable for signature).

Prep for the call: Ben, bring the retention-options one-pager and high-level SOW impact. Soojin, coordinate scheduling with FinSecure legal. I propose Wed (12 May) 09:00 UTC for a 30-min decision call; please confirm availability.

Laura
